issue_request: FHIR-8496 is a Published/Persuasive OO DSTU1 change request asking to add Observation.bodySite text that in many systems this information may be better represented as a related Observation instead of inline.
initial_application: Git commit 348686f20075ff53db8f62afc2a7a25ce7b99e57 explicitly included [#8496] and changed the then-authoritative observation spreadsheet so Observation.bodySite comments included the related-observation/inline-component guidance.
additional_context: Observation remains active in source/fhir.ini. The source was later refactored into structuredefinition-Observation.xml, Observation.bodyStructure was added as the replacement body structure element, and later bodySite deprecation/bodyStructure work preserved the same guidance on both bodySite and bodyStructure. FHIR-11293 quoted the bodySite note as existing context and requested only analogous specimen wording; bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml already includes the requested guidance on Observation.bodySite and carries equivalent guidance forward to Observation.bodyStructure.
